plugins.name: vibecoding
plugins.description: Toolkit di skill per spec-driven development. Include 7 skill (methodology, validation-strategies, change-request, agentify, skill-bootstrap, md-to-pdf, deep-research), comando /vibecoding:init con routing 3-vie delle desiderata in CLAUDE.md, PROJECT_SPEC e SKILL, e templates per moduli software e cartelle di lavorazione Claude. agentify scaffolda agenti standalone con ruoli tool-empowered: coding-agent (tool reali edit/shell/LSP derivati da opencode) e high-level-ops (run schedulate con autonomy gates L0-L5, tool-guard, audit trail, propose-and-confirm). deep-research porta il funnel di ricerca profonda multi-round con gate umani, cross-check a due gambe e blueprint full-auto.
